# Display snippets for docs/graphs.md

--8<-- [start:overview_import]
-import_from(graphs, [Vertices, ShortestPath, IsConnected])

Main <- (
    G = [["a", "b"], ["b", "c"], ["a", "c"]],
    Vertices(G, V),
    ++print(f"Vertices: {V}"),
    ShortestPath(G, "a", "c", P),
    ++print(f"Shortest path: {P}")
)
--8<-- [end:overview_import]

--8<-- [start:overview_module]
-import_module(graphs)

Main <- (
    G = [["a", "b"], ["b", "c"]],
    graphs.Vertices(G, V),
    graphs.IsConnected(G)
)
--8<-- [end:overview_module]

--8<-- [start:query_examples]
Vertices([["a", "b"], ["b", "c"]], V)    % V = ["a", "b", "c"]
Neighbors([["a", "b"], ["b", "c"]], "b", N)  % N = ["a", "c"]
Degree([["a", "b"], ["b", "c"]], "b", D)     % D = 2
--8<-- [end:query_examples]

--8<-- [start:traversal_example]
BreadthFirstNodes([["a", "b"], ["b", "c"], ["c", "d"]], "a", N)
# N = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
--8<-- [end:traversal_example]

--8<-- [start:pathfinding_examples]
# Enumerate all paths
FindPath([["a", "b"], ["b", "c"], ["a", "c"]], "a", "c", P)
# P = ["a", "b", "c"]  then  P = ["a", "c"]

# Shortest path in a weighted graph
ShortestPath([["a", "b", 1], ["b", "c", 2], ["a", "c", 10]], "a", "c", P)
# P = ["a", "b", "c"]

# Cost of a path
PathCost([["a", "b", 3], ["b", "c", 5]], ["a", "b", "c"], C)
# C = 8
--8<-- [end:pathfinding_examples]

--8<-- [start:component_examples]
ConnectedComponents([["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]], C)
# C = [["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]]

TopologicalSort([["a", "b"], ["b", "c"], ["a", "c"]], O)
# O = ["a", "b", "c"]
--8<-- [end:component_examples]

--8<-- [start:tree_example]
MinSpanningTree([["a", "b", 1], ["b", "c", 2], ["a", "c", 4]], T, C)
# T = [["a", "b", 1], ["b", "c", 2]]   C = 3
--8<-- [end:tree_example]

--8<-- [start:transform_example]
ReverseEdges([["a", "b"], ["c", "d"]], R)
# R = [["b", "a"], ["d", "c"]]
--8<-- [end:transform_example]
